keys.trxIntro: Beryth an hoole Nexvs unto anothyr enjyn. No rekonyng and no buyldyng — ythe sendyr shewyth a runemarke, ythe resevyr typyth yt, and ythe shadowe betwyxt vanyshyth ythe momenth yt landyth.
keys.trxPickNexus: Openyth ythe Nexvs thou wouldst sendyth.
keys.trxServiceHint: Leaveth emptye for ythe cheefe servyce, orr poynt yt at thyne owne DraconDex-TRX.
keys.trxAllowTypedHint: Lyt, ythe othyr enjyn maye typyth ythe runemarke and ythe PIN, but ythe servyce holdyth ythe kaye sealyd undyr that PIN whyle yt waytyth. Darke, ythe QR ys ythe onlye dore, and ythe servyce redyth noght at alle.
keys.trxModeTyped: Scanyth ythe QR, orr typyth ythe runemarke and ythe PIN. Whyle yt waytyth, ythe servyce holdyth ythe kaye sealyd undyr ythe PIN.
keys.trxModeQr: QR sygil alone. Ythe kaye reachyth ythe servyce nevyr, so noone save ythe scanyng enjyn openyth thys.
keys.trxExpiry: Thys fadyth in thyrtye mynuts, and vhoreth ythe momenth yt ys resevyd.
keys.trxClaimed: Ythe othyr enjyn hathe provyd ythe runemarke and drawyth yt downe…
keys.trxDone: Resevyd. Ythe shadowe upon ythe servyce ys vhoryd.
keys.trxExpiredNotice: Yt fadyd ere anye resevyd yt.
keys.trxReceiveHint: Askyth ythe sendyng enjyn for yts runemarke and PIN.
keys.trxReceiveAsNew: Yt comyth as a Nexvs vyrran. Noght thou holdyst alredye ys touchyd.
keys.trxErrBadCode: That runemarke orr PIN ys noth ryghth.
keys.trxErrLocked: To manye wrongyd PINs. Thys beryng lyeth lokyd a whyle.
keys.trxErrExpired: Thys beryng hathe fadyd. Askyth a runemarke vyrran.
keys.trxErrGone: Thys beryng abydyth no more — resevyd orr unmadyd.
keys.trxErrNotReady: Ythe othyr enjyn hathe noth yet fynyshyd sendyng.
keys.trxErrTooLarge: Thys Nexvs weyghyth more thanne oon beryng suffryth.
keys.trxErrBadToken: Thys beryng sessyon holdyth no more. Begynnyth agayn.
keys.trxErrBadKey: That lynk ys unhoole — ythe kaye parth lakyth orr ys marryd.
keys.trxErrQrOnly: Ythe sendyr suffryd ythe QR sygil alone. Scanyth yt, typyth yt noth.
keys.trxErrBadPayload: Ythe resevyd thyng myghth noth be redde.
keys.trxErrInvalidUrl: That servyce adresse ys noth goode — https alone.
keys.trxErrNotFound: That Nexvs myghth noth be founde.
keys.sbIntro: Useth thyne owne Supabaas projekth as ythe Kloudsynk hoard. Pastyth ythe projekth URL and ythe publishablyth kaye, and DraconDex shalle serchyth and buyldyth ythe tablyths yt nedyth.
keys.sbKeyStored: A kaye lyeth savyd alredye — leaveth thys emptye to kepyth yt.
keys.sbReady: Redye — thys projekth hathe alle that Kloudsynk nedyth.
keys.sbNeedSetup: Buyldyng nedyd — summe tablyths orr funkthyons be myssyng.
keys.sbNotChecked: Nought serchyd yet. Saveth ythe settyngs abovyth, thenn pressyth "Serchyth ythe Projekth".
keys.sbAutoInstallHint: A publishablyth kaye kannot kryne tablyths. Pastyth a Supabaas persynal akkess tokyn, and DraconDex shalle runnyth ythe buyldyng SQL for thee.
keys.sbAccessTokenHint: Usyd for thys onne askyng alonn — nevyr savyd.
keys.sbManualTitle: Orr buyldyth yt by thyne owne hande
keys.sbManualHint: Kopyth ythe SQL, runnyth yt yn thy projekth SQL zhakrii, thenn pressyth "Serchyth ythe Projekth" agayn.
